key_insight: Agora improves LLM-agent reasoning by auctioning reasoning steps to the best available expert model or tool instead of using coarse function matching.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical routing mechanism with a controllable cost-quality trade-off, helping systems allocate expensive calls more intelligently in multi-model agent workflows.
method: Models and tools bid for task allocation using rectified competence estimates.
Reasoning steps are treated as tradeable items in an incentive-compatible auction.
A single auction parameter controls the balance between quality and cost.
evidence_signal: Across five benchmarks, Agora outperforms matched single-model, routing, and cascade baselines when candidate pools are comparable.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of competence calibration and candidate pool design, so misestimated bids or limited expert coverage could reduce gains.
paper_title: Agora: Enhancing LLM Agent Reasoning Via Auction-Based Task Allocation
